title: Illustrative carbon intensity per completed job
method: Synthetic calculation: (energy in kWh times 300 gCO2e/kWh plus 5,000 gCO2e allocated hardware emissions) divided by 10,000 completed jobs. Energy changes from 100 to 80 kWh; other inputs and output quality are held constant.
alt: Illustrative carbon intensity per completed job: Original batch 3.5 gCO2e per job, Reduced-energy batch 2.9 gCO2e per job. Illustrative inputs.
